assets.description: A quiet one-to-one corner: two oat armchairs angled at a side table before a deep green end wall, a 20-pane factory window and a brass floor lamp; mid-afternoon autumn sun from the left.

A senior manager's corner office seen from its door: oak desk crossing the frame below a green end wall, two factory windows on the left, two visitor chairs with their backs to the camera; sun through window A grids the desk top.

The training room for 20 from the back corner: four rows of birch flip-top tables and stacking chairs, a lit 86-inch screen and flip chart on the green front wall, blinded factory windows on the left, corridor glass on the right.
